budget_formula: Three concurrent continuations per arm; 250 seconds and 30 actions per case; 600 second arm allowance includes replay/drain, 3600 second session cap.
comparison_note: Baseline first, candidate second, fresh CPU process and flushed model cache. Identical recorded frame/messages/functions; candidate only adds exact runs and field guidance. Diagnostic replay is not a natural full-pool score.
purpose: Isolated-process same-state comparison of 009 Python lifecycle versus exact segmentation runs; no program repair.
selection_note: Inspect actual executed runs reads, corrected pixel construction, subsequent action/level recovery and additional output. No improvement claim from restored historical prefix scores.
startup_io_note: Skip only redundant whole-directory model precache; SGLang shard lookahead/drop-cache and wheel pre-cache retained. Both arms share same unchanged numerical serving.
